about.text: Butter tea is a salty drink of the Himalayas and Tibet: strongly brewed tea, often pu-erh, churned with butter and salt in a wooden churn (mdong mo) until it is thick. Yak butter is traditional, cow butter is increasingly used, and it is drunk in many bowls a day for its calories at altitude.

how.text: The butter is not melted down first: it is churned straight into the hot salted tea until the two emulsify.
